title: VectorCraft border pattern file (.vcborder), version 1
description: One repeat of a stitched border, sewn end to end along a path. See vcborder.md.

id.description: Lower-case letters and digits joined by dashes; made from name when absent or empty.

source.description: A URL, or the design the pattern was taken from.

width.description: The band's width at the pattern's own size, mm.

length.description: One repeat's length at the pattern's own size, mm.

repeat.description: One repeat: parts sewn in order as one continuous line.

corner.description: A motif sewn at each sharp corner, drawn round the corner at (0, 0).

width.description: Satin: the column's width, mm at the pattern's size (1 when absent).
